quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical 2025 revenue RMB 5,163,432,471.16, up 58.79% (2024: RMB 3,251,707,626.61); net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 2,017,266,034.08, up 50.15%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 1,976,452,906.47, up 50.42%; operating cash flow RMB 1,868,203,465.93, up 47.97%. Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 944,631,274.77, Q2 RMB 1,511,259,024.73, Q3 RMB 1,462,512,812.49, Q4 RMB 1,245,029,359.17 (Q4 net profit RMB 551,910,198.25). The company attributes the growth to AI and global data-center build-outs driving steady growth in demand for high-speed optical devices, plus cost reduction from smart manufacturing; higher FX losses (RMB 47,523,153.95 in 2025) weighed on results.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical 2025 revenue by product: active optical devices RMB 2,997,945,108.74 (58.06% of revenue, up 81.11%, gross margin 46.63%, down 0.06 pt); passive optical devices RMB 2,084,386,267.76 (40.37%, up 32.23%, gross margin 63.67%, down 4.74 pt). Optical communication components overall RMB 5,082,331,376.50 at 53.62% gross margin (2024: 57.29%). Exports were 74.35% of revenue (RMB 3,838,979,169.95, gross margin 51.59%); sales to Asia excluding China RMB 3,766,769,863.81, to North America RMB 66,233,067.08. Raw materials rose to 74.56% of cost of sales, which the company attributes to the larger contribution of active optical devices with higher material cost.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical 2025 optical communication components: output 47,383.50 ten-thousand units (up 42.58%, mainly optical element output), sales volume 25,423.34 ten-thousand units (up 21.78%); year-end inventory 5,310.70 ten-thousand units (down 22.66%). Capacity and output include units used internally between product lines. Mass-production bases are in Jiangxi, China and Chonburi, Thailand; in 2025 the company accelerated the ramp of its Thailand plant.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical (annual report): in 2025 the company completed scale volume production of its 1.6T optical engine and completed R&D of CPO-supporting optical devices, and it is positioning in silicon photonics integration as a next-generation route; on passive devices it continued upgrading WDM devices, high-density connectors and micro-optic assemblies. Its product table lists BOX devices at 1.6T.

quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical 2025 R&D spending RMB 266,580,928.65, up 14.79%, 5.16% of revenue (2024: 7.14%), none capitalised; R&D staff 774 (up 40.98%, 15.10% of employees); 194 patents held in China and abroad at year-end.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical top five customers were 89.73% of 2025 sales (RMB 4,632,769,481.55); apart from the largest customer (63.31%), the second to fifth customers were 11.66%, 7.50%, 3.95% and 3.31% of sales, names not disclosed; sales to related parties among them 0.00%. The company lists customer concentration as a risk.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical top five suppliers were 61.51% of 2025 purchases (RMB 1,471,846,769.96); the largest 34.81% (RMB 832,889,806.30), then 8.24%, 7.82%, 6.12% and 4.52%; names not disclosed; related-party purchases 0.00%. The company says some key materials in the chain face periodic supply tightness, longer lead times and price swings due to upstream capacity release and yield ramps, which may affect order delivery, costs and new-product ramp; it is responding with diversified supply and safety stock.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical construction in progress RMB 202,951,337.39 at end-2025 (start of year RMB 233,452,063.37), mostly equipment awaiting installation and acceptance; the Jiangxi Tianfu Technology Park phase 2 (raised funds) and the Thailand plant building are at 100% project progress. The raised-fund high-speed optical engine project for 5G and data centers was completed and reached its intended usable state as of May 30, 2025. The company says the high-speed optical engine project has relatively low gross margin and its rising sales may lower overall gross margin, and that Thailand plant production costs are higher than in China during the early ramp as worker proficiency and utilisation improve.

quarterly_data.quarter: TFC Optical annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: TFC Optical 2026 business plan (company outlook): keep focusing on its core business and strive for steady growth in both quality and scale; use the opportunity of its H-share listing to keep expanding capacity and support customers' production ramps; accelerate its global capacity and supply-chain layout; and, anchored on what it calls the certain market demand from AI computing, focus on next-generation high-speed products and CPO.
